breaking_news.headline: The U.S.-Canada trade war is creating a headache for auto-parts makers
breaking_news.summary: For decades, the U.S. and Canadian auto supply chains have been tightly woven together. The trade war is threatening to unravel a complex system.

breaking_news.headline: From DOGE to "space lasers," Alex Gibney peels back the many layers of Elon Musk
breaking_news.summary: In the Oscar-winning filmmaker's latest documentary, director Alex Gibney investigates the rise of Elon Musk and says what's behind Musk's success are distressing truths.

breaking_news.headline: US diesel prices soar past $6 a gallon, deepening strain for hauling everyday goods
breaking_news.summary: Diesel prices in the U.S. has hit yet another record, soaring past $6 a gallon on average as Washington's war with Iran disrupts the world's flow of fuel

breaking_news.headline: Is Patagonia the new data center hub? + Harley-Davidson's role in the trade war
breaking_news.summary: Why Patagonia might become a new data center hub

breaking_news.headline: Amid war and sanctions, many Iranians are losing their jobs and struggling to get by
breaking_news.summary: Many Iranians lost their jobs because of the war and the U.S. blockade. Now some are even losing their backup jobs as sanctions tighten.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs call for AI development to slow down, OpenAI to delay IPO
breaking_news.summary: Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are the latest to urge caution amid fears the industry is racing too fast to build powerful AI while safety measures lag.

breaking_news.headline: A new tax incentive could lead to more films being made in the U.S. rather than abroad
breaking_news.summary: President Trump and Congress are weighing in on potential federal tax incentives for film production. It's hoped the tax credit would keep production of films and TV in the U.S. rather than overseas.

breaking_news.headline: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
breaking_news.summary: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

breaking_news.headline: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
breaking_news.summary: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

breaking_news.headline: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
breaking_news.summary: The "Sultan of Sequins" created iconic and dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner and Elton John.

breaking_news.headline: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
breaking_news.summary: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.

breaking_news.headline: US confirms for first time it has deployed space weapons
breaking_news.summary: The US Air Force Secretary says the weapons are necessary to defend the country against enemy action.

breaking_news.headline: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
breaking_news.summary: The origin of the drone is currently unknown, but authorities say it likely entered Lithuania from neighbouring Belarus, an ally of Russia.

breaking_news.headline: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
breaking_news.summary: He becomes the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night at the prestigious TV ceremony.

breaking_news.headline: Petrol and diesel prices hit highest since 2022
breaking_news.summary: The cost of filling up a vehicle has rebounded, according to the RAC, as oil prices remain elevated.

breaking_news.headline: Pubs, hotels and gyms in Wales to get 30% business rates cut
breaking_news.summary: The cuts comes into effect in April, but the largest businesses will pay higher rates to fund the changes.

breaking_news.headline: Government set to nationalise troubled steel firm
breaking_news.summary: Production at SSUK sites in South Yorkshire and the West Midlands was paused earlier this year.

breaking_news.headline: AI regulation faces political deadlock as calls grow for Congress to act
breaking_news.summary: With Trump opposed and Congress divided, new safety legislation on AI is unlikely to pass anytime soon despite mounting pressure.

breaking_news.headline: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
breaking_news.summary: New rules introduced on Tuesday mean establishments will be able to accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents.

breaking_news.headline: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: US President Donald Trump dismisses calls to slow the development of AI, saying that claims of it "taking over the World" are a "HOAX".
